## Core theme

Many social situations have the same underlying structure:

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A[Uncertainty] --> B[Beliefs]
    B --> C[Choices]
    C --> D[Strategic interaction]
    D --> E[Institutions]
    E --> F[Outcomes]
    F --> G[Learning or feedback]
    G --> B
```

The site studies this loop from different angles: formal models, criminological mechanisms, psychological processes, and institutional settings.

## Current focus

The site is currently being expanded around three priorities:

1. building useful anchor pages for game theory and foundations;
2. turning criminology placeholders into mechanism-based notes;
3. adding diagrams that show logical structure and concept connections.
